text: I’ll use a Mann–Kendall test with a year-normalized Sen slope, then a global four-factor varimax model mapped to Heat, Flow, Wind, and Human.

title:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pymannkendall as mk
from factor_analyzer import FactorAnalyzer
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

root = Path('/root/data')
water = pd.read_csv(root / 'water_temperature.csv')
climate = pd.read_csv(root / 'climate.csv')
hydrology = pd.read_csv(root / 'hydrology.csv')
land = pd.read_csv(root / 'land_cover.csv')
df = water.merge(climate, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').merge(hydrology, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').merge(land, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').sort_values('Year')

year = df['Year'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
temp = df['WaterTemperature'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
mk_result = mk.original_test(temp)
pair_slopes = [(temp[j] - temp[i]) / (year[j] - year[i]) for i in range(len(temp) - 1) for j in range(i + 1, len(temp))]
print('Mann-Kendall:', mk_result.trend, 'p=', mk_result.p, 'index-Sen slope=', mk_result.slope, 'year-Sen slope=', np.median(pair_slopes))

variables = ['AirTempLake', 'Shortwave', 'Longwave', 'Precip', 'Inflow', 'Outflow', 'WindSpeedLake', 'DevelopedArea', 'AgricultureArea']
categories = {'Heat': ['AirTempLake', 'Shortwave', 'Longwave'], 'Flow': ['Precip', 'Inflow', 'Outflow'], 'Wind': ['WindSpeedLake'], 'Human': ['DevelopedArea', 'AgricultureArea']}
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(df[variables])
fa = FactorAnalyzer(n_factors=4, rotation='varimax')
scores = fa.fit_transform(X)
loadings = pd.DataFrame(fa.loadings_, index=variables, columns=[f'factor_{index + 1}' for index in range(4)])
print('\nLoadings:\n', loadings.round(3))
print('\nCategory absolute loading totals:')
category_loadings = pd.DataFrame({name: loadings.loc[columns].abs().sum() for name, columns in categories.items()})
print(category_loadings.round(3))
print('category per factor:', category_loadings.idxmax().to_dict())

def r2(predictors, response):
    return LinearRegression().fit(predictors, response).score(predictors, response)

full = r2(scores, temp)
contrib = {}
for factor in range(4):
    without = np.delete(scores, factor, axis=1)
    category = category_loadings.iloc[factor].idxmax()
    contrib[category] = contrib.get(category, 0) + full - r2(without, temp)
print('\nfull R2', full)
print('contributions', {key: value * 100 for key, value in contrib.items()})
PY

+import numpy as np

+import pymannkendall as mk
+from factor_analyzer import FactorAnalyzer
+from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
+from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
+
+
+DATA_DIR = Path("/root/data")
+OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/root/output")
+
+
+def load_data():
+    water_temperature = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "water_temperature.csv")
+    climate = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "climate.csv")
+    hydrology = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "hydrology.csv")
+    land_cover = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "land_cover.csv")
+    return (
+        water_temperature.merge(climate, on="Year", validate="one_to_one")
+        .merge(hydrology, on="Year", validate="one_to_one")
+        .merge(land_cover, on="Year", validate="one_to_one")
+        .sort_values("Year")
+    )
+
+
+def sen_slope_per_year(years, values):
+    slopes = [
+        (values[j] - values[i]) / (years[j] - years[i])
+        for i in range(len(values) - 1)
+        for j in range(i + 1, len(values))
+    ]
+    return float(np.median(slopes))
+
+
+def calculate_r2(predictors, response):
+    return LinearRegression().fit(predictors, response).score(predictors, response)
+
+
+def main():
+    data = load_data()
+    years = data["Year"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+    water_temperature = data["WaterTemperature"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+
+    trend = mk.original_test(water_temperature)
+    trend_result = pd.DataFrame(
+        [{"slope": sen_slope_per_year(years, water_temperature), "p-value": trend.p}]
+    )
+
+    categories = {
+        "Heat": ["AirTempLake", "Shortwave", "Longwave"],
+        "Flow": ["Precip", "Inflow", "Outflow"],
+        "Wind": ["WindSpeedLake"],
+        "Human": ["DevelopedArea", "AgricultureArea"],
+    }
+    variables = [variable for group in categories.values() for variable in group]
+    predictors = StandardScaler().fit_transform(data[variables])
+    factor_model = FactorAnalyzer(n_factors=4, rotation="varimax")
+    factor_scores = factor_model.fit_transform(predictors)
+    loadings = pd.DataFrame(factor_model.loadings_, index=variables)
+
+    full_r2 = calculate_r2(factor_scores, water_temperature)
+    category_contributions = {category: 0.0 for category in categories}
+    for factor_index in range(factor_scores.shape[1]):
+        category = max(
+            categories,
+            key=lambda name: loadings.iloc[
+                [variables.index(variable) for variable in categories[name]], factor_index
+            ].abs().sum(),
+        )
+        reduced_scores = np.delete(factor_scores, factor_index, axis=1)
+        category_contributions[category] += full_r2 - calculate_r2(
+            reduced_scores, water_temperature
+        )
+
+    dominant_category = max(category_contributions, key=category_contributions.get)
+    dominant_factor = pd.DataFrame(
+        [
+            {
+                "variable": dominant_category,
+                "contribution": category_contributions[dominant_category] * 100,
+            }
+        ]
+    )

+    dominant_factor.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "dominant_factor.csv", index=False)
